motive_flip: I. Official story — MISSION: SECURE HELIUM-3 RESERVES (Voss's testimony).
II. The math doesn't work — "WHY ARE WE HAULING THE WHOLE MOON?"
III. Checksum mismatch — "helium-3" was inserted into the archive AFTER mission records were sealed.
IV. The ice wasn't cargo, it was fuel — "Mimas was never being transported intact. It was being spent."
V. The core reveal — not treasure, not a diamond: a 159-mile heterogeneous exotic body. Qiao: "It's not worth anything." / "That's the point."
